# Salesflare | Core Use Cases

| Use case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| Small team B2B follow-up | Verify that small team B2B follow-up really reduces manual maintenance with “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities - Advancing Phase - Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the main link. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Identify intent based on website visit | Use “List or Interactive Entry — Forming Customers and Opportunities — Advancing Phase — Triggering Next Step — Managing Reviews” as the primary link to verify that identifying intentions based on website access really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended to record the data completion rate, first response time, overdue follow-up, phase stay, AI recommendation adoption rate, and cost per active user. |
| Personalized email campaign | Using “lists or interactive entry - customer formation and business opportunities - advance phase” as the main link to trigger the next step - managing the double drive, to verify whether personalized mail activities actually reduce manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
| Reduction of CRM duplicates and missing follow-up | The main link, “List or interactive entry - formation of customer and business - push phase” - triggers the next step - manage the double disk, to verify whether the reduction in CRM back-up and missing follow-up really reduces manual maintenance. It is recommended that data integrity rates, first response times, late follow-up, stopovers, AI recommendation acceptance rates and cost per active user be recorded. |
